title: VTG CATS Broadway Souvenir Program 1982 Cast Booklet Andrew Lloyd Webber + Clip
descriptionText:
Vintage Cats Broadway souvenir program published by Dewynters Ltd. Early edition from 1982/1983 original Broadway era.
Includes full program booklet with cast and production details, along with a vintage newspaper review clipping.
Condition: shows normal vintage wear including spine wear, edge wear, and handling marks. No major tears or missing pages.
Great collectible for theater fans and Andrew Lloyd Webber collectors.
